prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline and whether you need performance marketing, SEO, creative/brand work, B2B demand gen, e‑commerce, or something else.

How to pick the best agency for you
- Define goals and KPIs (revenue, leads, traffic, ROAS, lifetime value).
- Know your budget (monthly ad spend + management/retainer).
- Match specialty to need: e‑commerce, B2B SaaS, local, enterprise, influencer, creative, etc.
- Check proven results: case studies, similar clients, transparent reporting.
- Evaluate team/tech: who will do the work, what tools they use, reporting cadence.
- Ask about contracts, cancellation, and how they measure attribution.

Reputable agencies with a strong presence in/near San Francisco
(These are examples to start your shortlist; verify current reviews, case studies and fit.)
- 3Q Digital — performance marketing, analytics and paid media.
- Wpromote — full‑service performance and strategic marketing (national firm with SF presence).
- Razorfish — large digital experience/creative agency (part of Publicis).
- iProspect — global performance marketing with SF office.
- Jellyfish — digital marketing and analytics with Bay Area presence.

Resources to compare agencies
- Clutch.co, G2, Agency Spotter, Google Partner directory — filter by service, industry and city.
- Ask for references and recent case studies showing the exact outcomes you care about.

Quick budget guide (rough)
- PPC management: management fees often 10–20% of ad spend or $1k–$5k+/mo.
- SEO retainer: $2k–$10k+/mo depending on scope and competition.
- Full‑service retainers: $5k–$30k+/mo for small to mid‑size programs; enterprise higher.
- One‑off site builds or rebrands: tens of thousands to $100k+.

If you want, I can:
- Shortlist 3–5 SF agencies matched to your goals and budget.
- Draft an RFP template and questions to ask finalists.
Tell me: what industry are you in, what are your top 2–3 goals, and what’s your monthly budget (retainer + ad spend)?
